title: CategoryFacet
description: A hierarchical category facet for a commerce surface. Renders a flat representation of the category tree (ancestry, selected value, and available children) with facet search. Dispatches selectPath, clearSelectedPath, search, and show-more/less actions.

CategoryFacetState.title: CategoryFacetState
CategoryFacetState.description: The current category facet state. Owned exclusively by the backend. Presents a flat view of the category hierarchy: the ancestry path, the currently selected value, and the children available for further navigation.

field.description: The index field this facet operates on.

displayName.description: The human-readable label for this facet.

values.description: The flat representation of the category hierarchy.

canShowMoreValues.description: Whether more child values can be shown at the current level.

canShowLessValues.description: Whether the number of shown child values can be reduced.

facetSearch.description: The current category facet search state.

CategoryFacetValues.title: CategoryFacetValues
CategoryFacetValues.description: Flat representation of the category hierarchy. When no category is selected, ancestry and selected are null and children contains the top-level categories.

ancestry.description: The ordered list of ancestor categories leading to the selected value, from the root down. Empty when no category is selected.

selected.description: The currently selected category value. Null when no category is selected.

children.description: The child categories available for navigation. When no category is selected, these are the top-level categories. When a category is selected, these are its direct children.

CategoryFacetSearch.title: CategoryFacetSearch
CategoryFacetSearch.description: The current category facet search state.

canShowMoreResults.description: Whether more facet search results can be shown for the current query.

CategoryFacetSelectPathAction.title: categoryFacetSelectPath
CategoryFacetSelectPathAction.description: Navigates to a category by selecting its path.

path.description: The path of the category to select.

CategoryFacetClearSelectedPathAction.title: categoryFacetClearSelectedPath
CategoryFacetClearSelectedPathAction.description: Clears the current category selection, navigating back to the root.

CategoryFacetSearchAction.title: categoryFacetSearch
CategoryFacetSearchAction.description: Runs a category facet search for the given query.

CategoryFacetShowMoreSearchResultsAction.title: categoryFacetShowMoreSearchResults
CategoryFacetShowMoreSearchResultsAction.description: Requests the next page of category facet search results.

CategoryFacetClearSearchAction.title: categoryFacetClearSearch
CategoryFacetClearSearchAction.description: Clears the category facet search query and results.

CategoryFacetShowMoreValuesAction.title: categoryFacetShowMoreValues
CategoryFacetShowMoreValuesAction.description: Increases the number of child category values shown.

CategoryFacetShowLessValuesAction.title: categoryFacetShowLessValues
CategoryFacetShowLessValuesAction.description: Decreases the number of child category values shown.

CategoryFacetValue.title: CategoryFacetValue
CategoryFacetValue.description: A single category value. Used throughout the category facet state (ancestry, selected value, children) and as facet search results.

path.description: The ordered path of category segments from the root to this value.

value.description: The display label of this category.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results matching this category.
